title: aether_converter ingest job
description: Job consumed by `aether_converter ingest --job-file <json>`. The file may be a single job object OR a JSON array of job objects (batch). Authoritative source: crates/aether_converter/src/ingest.rs (IngestJob).

format.description: Tile payload format; defaults to r16sint behavior when absent.

resolution_m.description: Metres per pixel. Sources finer than this are area-averaged over each output pixel's footprint (no-data excluded from the mean); a source at or coarser than this is taken as-is, never interpolated. See CONTRACT.md section 6.

base_tif.description: Base DEM GeoTIFF to sample, where no swiss_tifs cover the pixel. Area-averaged like every other source.

swiss_tifs.description: Higher-resolution swissALTI GeoTIFFs to overlay. REQUIRED field; may be an empty array.

buildings_file.description: FlatGeobuf building footprints to burn in. Roof height is read from geometry Z only; attribute heights are ignored.

buildings_pbf_dir.description: Directory of {z}_{x}_{y}.pbf vector tiles (gzip or plain) to burn in. Height ladder: render_height, then building:levels x 3, then a 6 m default, read as above-ground. All tiles must share one zoom level.
